text: Check the pot with a grown-up. If the soil feels dry, give it a little water. More days pass, and new leaves grow!
Check the soil with a grown-up. Rain may have watered it. If it feels dry, give it a gentle drink. More days pass, and leaves grow!
Cover the seed with a little soil. Keep it cozy, not squashed.
Daisy! Would you like to grow it inside in a pot, or outside in a garden?
Fill the pot with potting mix. Leave a little space at the top.
Give the soil a gentle drink. Plants need water, but not a puddle.
Growing takes many days. Let's pretend time passes. Tiny roots are growing under the soil!
Growing takes many days. Let's pretend time passes. Tiny roots spread through the garden soil!
Hello, little sprout! A green shoot is peeking up out of the garden.
Keep giving your plant light and the water it needs. After more growing time, a little flower bud appears!
Let's grow inside! Choose a pot with holes underneath so extra water can drain away.
Let's grow outside! Find a sunny spot in our pretend garden.
Marigold! Would you like to grow it inside in a pot, or outside in a garden?
More days pass. Our garden flower opens its petals. It is in full bloom! You helped it grow.
More days pass. The petals open wide. Our flower is in full bloom! You helped it grow.
Our indoor garden is ready. Let's choose a pot for our flower.
Our outdoor garden is ready. Let's choose a sunny planting spot.
Peekaboo, little sprout! A green shoot is reaching up toward the light.
Put a flower marker beside the seed. Now we can remember where we planted it.
Set the pot by a sunny window. Light helps our plant grow.
Sunflower! Would you like to grow it inside in a pot, or outside in a garden?
Tuck one seed into the soil. This is where our flower begins.
Use a little trowel to loosen the garden soil. Make room for our seed and its roots.
Which flower would you like to grow? Pick your favorite!
With a grown-up, clear little weeds around our flower. Keep caring as more days pass. Look, a flower bud!
